topic: MAC address processing and data generation
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on generating a list of MAC addresses for testing purposes. Initially, [me] requested assistance in identifying device details from test captive logs. [p1] offered to generate the necessary IDs using a specialized tool/script, as manual calculation (e.g., via Python or pg/ch) was deemed impractical due to technical limitations like the lack of bcrypt support in pg/ch. [p1] subsequently completed and shared the generated data for 'MAC for CP network'.
decisions: The MAC address list generation task was assigned to [p1].
